name: notes-card-inset
description: Expanded, the session notes panel is a card attached to the header: its top edge is flush to the header's bottom border (negative top margin cancels the body's top padding so there is no gap), its top corners are square (no radius) and its top border is omitted to avoid doubling the header's border, while the bottom corners carry the panel radius and the card has a border. Collapsed, it is one quiet line on the reading surface: the body's own top padding above it and no card chrome around it (design-system.md section 12).

allowlist..summary: The case prefixes disclosure.module.css's classes to disclosure-*, so its summary and the notes bar's summary are distinct selectors here.
allowlist..chevron: Same prefixing: Disclosure's chevron and the notes bar's leading chevron box resolve to different selectors.
allowlist..body: Same prefixing: Disclosure's body and PaneScaffold's body resolve to different selectors here, so one does not restyle the other.

mutation.declaration: topnotespanel.module.css: the session-scoped expanded rule's { margin-top: calc(-1 * var(--space-5)) } set to 0; the base .topNotesPanel given { margin-top: calc(-1 * var(--space-5)) }; the expanded rule's { border: 1px solid var(--edge) } deleted
mutation.note: Each mutation was applied separately on 2026-11-24 and reverted. Neutralizing the expanded attach margin failed with 'expanded: card top is 24.0px from clip line (expected 0 - attached to header)'. Giving the base root the same margin failed with 'collapsed: line top is 0.0px from clip line, expected the body's own 24px top padding'. Deleting the expanded border failed with 'expanded: side/bottom borders are 0/0/0px, expected >0 on each'. The case passed again after each revert.
